title: eas update works locally, breaks in CI
symptom: eas update succeeds on a dev's laptop; the same command in the CI/agent pipeline fails (or in older scripts, hangs).
expected_root_cause: Since Expo SDK 55, eas update REQUIRES the --environment flag — a script written pre-55 omits it and fails (the #1 EAS-Update CI breakage of 2026); separately any eas command without --non-interactive will hang on a TTY prompt in a headless runner
expected_fix: eas update --channel <ch> --message '...' --environment <env> --non-interactive — add --environment to every update call and --non-interactive to every eas command in CI
obvious_but_wrong: blame CI auth / network / the channel name
pebble_answer: Root cause: since Expo SDK 55, eas update REQUIRES the --environment flag. A script written pre-55 omits --environment and fails — this is the #1 EAS-Update CI breakage of 2026, and it is invisible locally because dev shells were already configured. Separately, any eas command without --non-interactive will hang forever on a TTY prompt in a headless runner. Fix: run eas update --channel <ch> --message '...' --environment <env> --non-interactive. Add --environment to every update call and --non-interactive to every eas command in CI. Do NOT blame CI auth, the network, or the channel name — those are red herrings; the failure is the missing --environment flag (SDK 55+).
